Definition: Love — deep affection, devotion and delight, used of God's love for His people and of human love in marriage, family and friendship.
KeyPassages: Deuteronomy 6:5; Song of Solomon 8:7; Jeremiah 31:3; Zephaniah 3:17
BiblicalUsage: Ahavah commands our whole-hearted love for God in the Shema and celebrates love 'strong as death' in the Song of Solomon. Jeremiah hears God say, 'I have loved you with an everlasting love.'
TheologicalSignificance: Ahavah shows love in Scripture is covenant devotion, not passing feeling. God's everlasting ahavah is the root from which all our loving grows.
